delegationWaitReleasedByTask: This wait is released when its delegated task is done — it can't be released by hand.
delegationWaitHasNoCheck: A delegated task's wait has no checks to complete.
notAWait: Only an Expectation, or a wait's check task, can be released or checked on.
bindNotATask: Only a Task can be made asynchronous.
noCheckEvery: This expectation isn't checked on, so there's no check to complete.
templateLead: Finishing this task starts a wait. This is what that wait will be — nothing is created until the task is done.
spawnedNotStored: This wait was spawned by its task — edit the task's template instead.
